summary: The decathalon datalist loader is implemented but not verified by running anything: I was asked not to run tests, black, or flake8. Changes: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new, with load_decathalon_datalist and a private helper, standard library only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py (new, four tests in TestLoadDecathalonDatalist, each cleaning up its temp directory). I checked by reading that no new line exceeds 120 columns and collapsed calls black would join. Judgment calls: items without image or label are passed through unchanged; a non-list value under the key raises ValueError; invalid JSON is re-raised as ValueError naming the file; items are copied rather than mutated. Nothing is committed.
